msg_calibration_timeout.english: The calibration did not finish. Try again.

auto_detect_active_toggle.english: Auto-detect active: toggle desired AUX channel

msg_auto_detect_lock_first.english: Auto-detect is active for this row. Toggle to lock AUX first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_first.translation: Autodetec. activa. Activar para bloquear AUX primero.

msg_auto_detect_lock_save.english: Auto-detect is active. Toggle the desired AUX channel first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_save.translation: Autodetec. activa. Activar canal AUX deseado primero.

msg_reset_tail_view.english: Reset view yaw so the tail faces you?

help_p1.english: Copy PID profile or Rate profile from Source to Destination.
help_p1.translation: Copiar perfil PID o Rate del origen al destino.

help_p2.english: Choose the source and destinations and save to copy the profile.
help_p2.translation: Elige origen y destino y guarda para copiar.

msgbox_copy_fmt.english: Copy %s Profile %d to Profile %d? This permanently overwrites Profile %d in the flight controller.
msgbox_copy_fmt.translation: Copy %s Profile %d to Profile %d? This permanently overwrites Profile %d in the flight controller.

msgbox_msg.english: Save current page to flight controller?

confirm_prompt.english: Apply packet rate and telemetry ratio changes to the RF module / Flight Controller?
confirm_prompt.translation: Apply packet rate and telemetry ratio changes to the RF module / Flight Controller?

status_requires_active_link.english: This tool requires an active CRSF link

status_wf_config_not_ready.english: Wingflight telemetry config was not ready

motor_override_disable_msg.english: Return control of the motor to the flight controller.
motor_override_disable_msg.translation: Return control of the motor to the flight controller.

motor_override_enable_msg.english: The flight controller drives the motor directly. Remove the propeller, secure the model and stand clear.
motor_override_enable_msg.translation: The flight controller drives the motor directly. Remove the propeller, secure the model and stand clear.

motor_override_note.english: Propeller off and the model secured.
motor_override_note.translation: Propeller off and the model secured.

motor_override_note_2.english: The motor turns with the throttle.
motor_override_note_2.translation: The motor turns with the throttle.

error_busy.english: MSP queue is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
error_busy.translation: La cola MSP está ocupada. Espere un momento y vuelva a intentarlo.

error_check_power.english: Check ESC power and wiring, then try again.
error_check_power.translation: Verifique la alimentación y el cableado del ESC, luego inténtelo nuevamente.

error_choose_esc.english: Use the matching ESC manufacturer page.
error_choose_esc.translation: Utilice la página del fabricante ESC correspondiente.

error_failed.translation: Error en la programación de ESC.

error_wrong_esc.translation: Se seleccionó el tipo de ESC incorrecto.

extra_msg_save.english: Please reboot the ESC to apply the changes
extra_msg_save.translation: Renicie el ESC para aplicar los cambios

msg_no_columns.english: No plottable columns in this file

msg_open_failed.translation: No se puede abrir el archivo de registro

axis_gain_help.english: Scales every rule reading a stabilized axis by a single percentage, and Invert flips that axis's direction for every rule reading it at once -- handy when setting up a new model without editing each mixer rule individually.
axis_gain_help.translation: Escala cada lectura de regla en un eje estabilizado por un porcentaje único, e Invertir cambia la dirección de ese eje para cada lectura de regla a la vez -- útil al configurar un modelo nuevo sin editar cada regla

disable_swash_override_message.english: Disable swash setup mode and return mixer control to the flight controller.
disable_swash_override_message.translation: Desactivar modo plato y devolver control mixer al controlador de vuelo.

enable_swash_override_message.english:
Enable passthrough mixer override so you can move the sticks while adjusting swash geometry. 

Live changes from this page are sent to the flight controller.
enable_swash_override_message.translation: Activar bypass del mixer para mover sticks al ajustar geometría del plato. Los cambios de esta página se envían al controlador de vuelo.

auto_detect_active.english: Auto-detect active: toggle desired AUX channel

msg_auto_detect_lock_first.english: Auto-detect is active for this row. Toggle to lock AUX first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_first.translation: Autodetec. activa. Activar para bloquear AUX primero.

msg_auto_detect_lock_save.english: Auto-detect is active. Toggle the desired AUX channel first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_save.translation: Autodetec. activa. Activar canal AUX deseado primero.

msg_no_free_slots.english: No free mode slots remain. Delete an existing range first.
msg_no_free_slots.translation: Sin ranuras modo libres. Eliminar un rango existente.

no_ranges.english: No ranges configured for this mode.

start_prompt.english: Would you like to start the test? Choose the test run time below.
start_prompt.translation: Desea comenzar la prueba? A continuacion seleccione el tiempo de ejecución.

no_ports_reported.english: No serial ports reported by FC.

save_armed.english: Saved; written to flash on disarm
save_armed.translation: Saved; written to flash on disarm

reload_alerts_prompt.translation: R¿cargar la configuración de alerta de energía local?

save_alerts_prompt.translation: ¿Guardar la configuración de alerta de energía local?

not_configured.english: No port is assigned the backup RX function.
not_configured.translation: No port is assigned the backup RX function.

disable_servo_override_msg.english: Return control of the servos to the flight controller.
disable_servo_override_msg.translation: Devolver el control de los servos al controlador de vuelo.

enable_servo_override_msg.english: Servo override allows you to 'trim' your servo center point in real time.
enable_servo_override_msg.translation: La toma de control del servo permite ajustar en tiempo real el punto central de su servo.

no_themes_available_to_configure.english: No configurable themes installed on this device
no_themes_available_to_configure.translation: No hay temas configurables instalados en este dispositivo

air_custom.english: This model uses a custom mix from Mixer Rules. Choose a type to replace it, or keep it.
air_custom.translation: This model uses a custom mix from Mixer Rules. Choose a type to replace it, or keep it.

air_q_follow.english: Should the flaps move with the ailerons too?
air_q_follow.translation: Should the flaps move with the ailerons too?

air_q_type.english: What kind of model is it?
air_q_type.translation: What kind of model is it?

air_too_few_fmt.english: It needs %d servo outputs and this board has %d. The surfaces past them won't move.
air_too_few_fmt.translation: It needs %d servo outputs and this board has %d. The surfaces past them won't move.

air_tv_removed.english: The thrust vectoring rules are replaced too: set them up again in the Configurator.
air_tv_removed.translation: The thrust vectoring rules are replaced too: set them up again in the Configurator.

cen_done.english: Every surface is at its center.
cen_done.translation: Every surface is at its center.

cen_far.english: Far from the servo's normal center. Move the horn instead, or this side loses travel.
cen_far.translation: Far from the servo's normal center. Move the horn instead, or this side loses travel.

cen_flap.english: Flaps are held at flaps up: set them in line with the wing.
cen_flap.translation: Flaps are held at flaps up: set them in line with the wing.

cen_intro.english: The surfaces are held at center. Set the horn and linkage so the surface is close to neutral first, then fine-tune here.
cen_intro.translation: The surfaces are held at center. Set the horn and linkage so the surface is close to neutral first, then fine-tune here.

dir_cant_fix_fmt.english: Servo %s also works another axis, so reversing it would break that one. Change its mix in Mixer Rules.
dir_cant_fix_fmt.translation: Servo %s also works another axis, so reversing it would break that one. Change its mix in Mixer Rules.

dir_done_ok.english: Every surface moves the right way.
dir_done_ok.translation: Every surface moves the right way.

dir_expect_flap.english: Flaps: both trailing edges go down.
dir_expect_flap.translation: Flaps: both trailing edges go down.

dir_expect_pitch.english: Elevator, elevons and V-tail: trailing edges go up.
dir_expect_pitch.translation: Elevator, elevons and V-tail: trailing edges go up.

dir_expect_roll.english: The right aileron or elevon goes up and the left one goes down.
dir_expect_roll.translation: The right aileron or elevon goes up and the left one goes down.

dir_expect_yaw.english: Rudder and V-tail: trailing edges move to the right, seen from behind.
dir_expect_yaw.translation: Rudder and V-tail: trailing edges move to the right, seen from behind.

dir_flap_radio.english: This makes a positive flap channel move the flaps down. If your flap switch then works the wrong way round, reverse the flap channel on the radio.
dir_flap_radio.translation: This makes a positive flap channel move the flaps down. If your flap switch then works the wrong way round, reverse the flap channel on the radio.

dir_identify_fmt.english: Servo %d (%s) is wiggling now, %d of %d. Did it move the wrong way?
dir_identify_fmt.translation: Servo %d (%s) is wiggling now, %d of %d. Did it move the wrong way?

dir_intro.english: Hands off the sticks. The wizard moves each control surface in turn. Watch the model and say whether it moves the way the picture shows.
dir_intro.translation: Hands off the sticks. The wizard moves each control surface in turn. Watch the model and say whether it moves the way the picture shows.

dir_q_all.english: Did all the highlighted surfaces move the wrong way?
dir_q_all.translation: Did all the highlighted surfaces move the wrong way?

dir_q_match.english: Do the highlighted surfaces move like the arrows?
dir_q_match.translation: Do the highlighted surfaces move like the arrows?

disconnected.english: No link to the flight controller.
disconnected.translation: No link to the flight controller.

fin_before.english: Before the first flight: fit the propeller, check the surfaces follow the sticks and push against movement with PASSTHROUGH off, and do a range check.
fin_before.translation: Before the first flight: fit the propeller, check the surfaces follow the sticks and push against movement with PASSTHROUGH off, and do a range check.

fin_intro.english: That's the setup done. Here is what the model has.
fin_intro.translation: That's the setup done. Here is what the model has.

gyr_done.english: The stabilizer pushes the right way on every axis.
gyr_done.translation: The stabilizer pushes the right way on every axis.

gyr_intro.english: Now the stabilizer drives the surfaces. The wizard turns ANGLE mode on: tilt the model by hand and hold it, and the surfaces should push back toward level.
gyr_intro.translation: Now the stabilizer drives the surfaces. The wizard turns ANGLE mode on: tilt the model by hand and hold it, and the surfaces should push back toward level.

gyr_no_angle.english: ANGLE mode isn't on: the surfaces may only react while the model moves.
gyr_no_angle.translation: ANGLE mode isn't on: the surfaces may only react while the model moves.

gyr_roll.english: Roll the model so the right wing drops.
gyr_roll.translation: Roll the model so the right wing drops.

gyr_wrong.english: If the surfaces were right in the Direction step but wrong here, the board orientation doesn't match how the board is mounted. Run the Sensors step again; don't reverse servos for this.
gyr_wrong.translation: If the surfaces were right in the Direction step but wrong here, the board orientation doesn't match how the board is mounted. Run the Sensors step again; don't reverse servos for this.

gyr_yaw.english: Swing the nose to the right.
gyr_yaw.translation: Swing the nose to the right.

leave_body.english: Save the wizard's changes to the flight controller, or discard them?
leave_body.translation: Save the wizard's changes to the flight controller, or discard them?

lim_done.english: Every surface has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.
lim_done.translation: Every surface has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.

lim_flap.english: These are the flap end points: Max is full flap. The wizard sets the flap travel to land on them.
lim_flap.translation: These are the flap end points: Max is full flap. The wizard sets the flap travel to land on them.

lim_intro.english: Find how far each servo can move before the surface or linkage binds, one side per screen. These limits protect the servo; throw is set later, in the Throws step.
lim_intro.translation: Find how far each servo can move before the surface or linkage binds, one side per screen. These limits protect the servo; throw is set later, in the Throws step.

lim_todo_max.english: Press + until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.
lim_todo_max.translation: Press + until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

lim_todo_min.english: Press - until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.
lim_todo_min.translation: Press - until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

missing_servos_fmt.english: Servo %s is mixed but this board has no output for it, so the wizard leaves it out.
missing_servos_fmt.translation: Servo %s is mixed but this board has no output for it, so the wizard leaves it out.

mod_arm_missing.english: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the model can't be armed.
mod_arm_missing.translation: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the model can't be armed.

mod_arm_on.english: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.
mod_arm_on.translation: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.

mod_flick.english: Flick the switch to the on position now...
mod_flick.translation: Flick the switch to the on position now...

mod_help_arm.english: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.
mod_help_arm.translation: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.

mod_help_att_hold.english: Let go of a stick and the model holds its attitude on that axis.
mod_help_att_hold.translation: Let go of a stick and the model holds its attitude on that axis.

mod_help_auto_trim.english: Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm: the trim is saved.
mod_help_auto_trim.translation: Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm: the trim is saved.

mod_help_manual.english: Stabilization off, with your rates kept. A good bail-out.
mod_help_manual.translation: Stabilization off, with your rates kept. A good bail-out.

mod_help_passthrough.english: A bench tool, not a flight mode: sticks straight to the surfaces. Put it on a switch you won't hit in flight.
mod_help_passthrough.translation: A bench tool, not a flight mode: sticks straight to the surfaces. Put it on a switch you won't hit in flight.

mod_help_trainer.english: The stabilizer stops the model rolling or pitching past its limits.
mod_help_trainer.translation: The stabilizer stops the model rolling or pitching past its limits.

mod_intro.english: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.
mod_intro.translation: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.

mod_no_slot.english: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.
mod_no_slot.translation: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.

mot_changed.english: The new protocol takes effect after a restart.
mot_changed.translation: The new protocol takes effect after a restart.

mot_dshot150_help.english: Digital, tolerant of long leads. No bidirectional RPM.
mot_dshot150_help.translation: Digital, tolerant of long leads. No bidirectional RPM.

mot_dshot150_rpm.english: Motor RPM needs DShot300 or an RPM or ESC telemetry source.
mot_dshot150_rpm.translation: Motor RPM needs DShot300 or an RPM or ESC telemetry source.

mot_dshot300_help.english: Digital, no calibration; BLHeli, Bluejay, AM32.
mot_dshot300_help.translation: Digital, no calibration; BLHeli, Bluejay, AM32.

mot_dshot600_help.english: Faster DShot, for ESCs that support it.
mot_dshot600_help.translation: Faster DShot, for ESCs that support it.

mot_intro.english: How the flight controller talks to the ESC.
mot_intro.translation: How the flight controller talks to the ESC.

mot_no_outputs.english: This board has no motor output set up.
mot_no_outputs.translation: This board has no motor output set up.

mot_none_help.english: Gliders, or a motor not on the flight controller.
mot_none_help.translation: Gliders, or a motor not on the flight controller.

mot_other_help.english: No motor, DShot600 (short ESC leads only) and the rest.
mot_other_help.translation: No motor, DShot600 (short ESC leads only) and the rest.

mot_prop_text.english: The motor is about to spin. Remove the propeller and hold the model.
mot_prop_text.translation: The motor is about to spin. Remove the propeller and hold the model.

mot_pwm_help.english: Works with any ESC; some need their throttle range calibrated.
mot_pwm_help.translation: Works with any ESC; some need their throttle range calibrated.

mot_spin_text.english: It spins for a few seconds and stops by itself, or within a second if the link drops. Check it starts smoothly and turns the right way; if not, swap two motor wires or reverse it in the ESC.
mot_spin_text.translation: It spins for a few seconds and stops by itself, or within a second if the link drops. Check it starts smoothly and turns the right way; if not, swap two motor wires or reverse it in the ESC.

needs_firmware.english: The Setup Wizard needs flight controller firmware with MSP API 22.14 or newer, which can hold the surfaces safely. Update the firmware, or use the Configurator.
needs_firmware.translation: The Setup Wizard needs flight controller firmware with MSP API 22.14 or newer, which can hold the surfaces safely. Update the firmware, or use the Configurator.

no_surfaces.english: No control surfaces are mixed yet. Set up the mix in Mixer Rules or with the Configurator's Setup Wizard, then come back.
no_surfaces.translation: No control surfaces are mixed yet. Set up the mix in Mixer Rules or with the Configurator's Setup Wizard, then come back.

refused.english: Disarm: the FC refused setup mode.
refused.translation: Disarm: the FC refused setup mode.

rx_check.english: Put both sticks in the bottom-left corner. Every bar should go to the left.
rx_check.translation: Put both sticks in the bottom-left corner. Every bar should go to the left.

rx_move_pitch.english: Move pitch (elevator) all the way, and leave the others still.
rx_move_pitch.translation: Move pitch (elevator) all the way, and leave the others still.

rx_move_roll.english: Move roll (aileron) all the way, and leave the others still.
rx_move_roll.translation: Move roll (aileron) all the way, and leave the others still.

rx_move_throttle.english: Move throttle all the way, and leave the others still.
rx_move_throttle.translation: Move throttle all the way, and leave the others still.

rx_move_yaw.english: Move yaw (rudder) all the way, and leave the others still.
rx_move_yaw.translation: Move yaw (rudder) all the way, and leave the others still.

rx_reversed.english: A bar going right is reversed: reverse that channel on your radio, not here.
rx_reversed.translation: A bar going right is reversed: reverse that channel on your radio, not here.

sen_acc_failed.english: The calibration did not finish. Try again.
sen_acc_failed.translation: The calibration did not finish. Try again.

sen_acc_text.english: Hold the model level and still, then press Calibrate.
sen_acc_text.translation: Hold the model level and still, then press Calibrate.

sen_align_done_fmt.english: Board orientation found: roll %d, pitch %d, yaw %d degrees.
sen_align_done_fmt.translation: Board orientation found: roll %d, pitch %d, yaw %d degrees.

sen_align_lift.english: Now lift the tail by at least 20 degrees and hold it...
sen_align_lift.translation: Now lift the tail by at least 20 degrees and hold it...

sen_align_text.english: Place the model flat, press Start, then lift the tail by at least 20 degrees.
sen_align_text.translation: Place the model flat, press Start, then lift the tail by at least 20 degrees.

sen_check_text.english: Tilt the model right and left, then nose down and up: the picture must follow every movement. If it doesn't, go back and find the orientation again.
sen_check_text.translation: Tilt the model right and left, then nose down and up: the picture must follow every movement. If it doesn't, go back and find the orientation again.

sen_done_restart.english: The flight controller restarts to use the new orientation and level. The wizard carries on afterwards.
sen_done_restart.translation: The flight controller restarts to use the new orientation and level. The wizard carries on afterwards.

sen_intro.english: The flight controller needs to know how it is mounted and which way is level. Power on with the model still: the gyro calibrates itself at power-up.
sen_intro.translation: The flight controller needs to know how it is mounted and which way is level. Power on with the model still: the gyro calibrates itself at power-up.

sen_level_done_fmt.english: Mounting trim set: roll %.1f, pitch %.1f degrees.
sen_level_done_fmt.translation: Mounting trim set: roll %.1f, pitch %.1f degrees.

sen_level_text.english: Hold the model in its flying attitude and keep it still while it measures.
sen_level_text.translation: Hold the model in its flying attitude and keep it still while it measures.

sen_no_acc.english: No accelerometer found, so the board orientation and level can't be set here.
sen_no_acc.translation: No accelerometer found, so the board orientation and level can't be set here.

sen_no_match.english: No orientation matched. Lift the tail further and keep the wings level.
sen_no_match.translation: No orientation matched. Lift the tail further and keep the wings level.

sen_out_of_range.english: The model is too far from level. Hold it closer to its flying attitude.
sen_out_of_range.translation: The model is too far from level. Hold it closer to its flying attitude.

sen_tail.english: On a tail wheel or skid, prop the tail up until the fuselage is level, as in flight, for the calibration and the level step.
sen_tail.translation: On a tail wheel or skid, prop the tail up until the fuselage is level, as in flight, for the calibration and the level step.

sen_timeout.english: Nothing was measured in time. Try again.
sen_timeout.translation: Nothing was measured in time. Try again.

sen_unsupported.english: This firmware can't do this automatically. Set it on the Alignment page.
sen_unsupported.translation: This firmware can't do this automatically. Set it on the Alignment page.

st_analog_help.english: 50 Hz, works with any standard servo.
st_analog_help.translation: 50 Hz, works with any standard servo.

st_applied_fmt.english: %s set on every surface servo. It takes effect after a restart.
st_applied_fmt.translation: %s set on every surface servo. It takes effect after a restart.

st_digital_help.english: 333 Hz, check your servos support it.
st_digital_help.translation: 333 Hz, check your servos support it.

st_intro.english: What kind of servos drive the control surfaces?
st_intro.translation: What kind of servos drive the control surfaces?

st_narrow_help.english: 560 Hz, only for 760 us servos; resets center, limits and scale.
st_narrow_help.translation: 560 Hz, only for 760 us servos; resets center, limits and scale.

sty_intro.english: Choose the style closest to how you fly. It sets how fast the model turns at full stick.
sty_intro.translation: Choose the style closest to how you fly. It sets how fast the model turns at full stick.

tg_auto_note.english: Use Auto trim: give it a switch in Mode switches. Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm.
tg_auto_note.translation: Use Auto trim: give it a switch in Mode switches. Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm.

tg_button_none_fmt.english: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).
tg_button_none_fmt.translation: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).

tg_buttons_check.english: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.
tg_buttons_check.translation: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.

tg_full.english: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.
tg_full.translation: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.

tg_gain_centre.english: Fly the first flight with it at center.
tg_gain_centre.translation: Fly the first flight with it at center.

tg_gain_q.english: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down in flight: fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.
tg_gain_q.translation: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down in flight: fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.

tg_how_buttons.english: On the radio: in Trims keep the aileron, elevator and rudder trims. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per trim button at these weights: T1 Left 70, T1 Right 80, T2 Up 60, T2 Down 50, T4 Left 30, T4 Right 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.
tg_how_buttons.translation: On the radio: in Trims keep the aileron, elevator and rudder trims. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per trim button at these weights: T1 Left 70, T1 Right 80, T2 Up 60, T2 Down 50, T4 Left 30, T4 Right 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.

tg_how_channels.english: On the radio: set the aileron, elevator and rudder trims to Coarse. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add free mixes ROLL TRIM, PITCH TRIM and YAW TRIM: always on, source that trim, Add, 100%, each on its own spare channel. Then press Detect and press each trim when asked.
tg_how_channels.translation: On the radio: set the aileron, elevator and rudder trims to Coarse. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add free mixes ROLL TRIM, PITCH TRIM and YAW TRIM: always on, source that trim, Add, 100%, each on its own spare channel. Then press Detect and press each trim when asked.

tg_intro.english: Two things you'll want in the air on the first flights: a way to trim, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.
tg_intro.translation: Two things you'll want in the air on the first flights: a way to trim, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.

tg_trim_q.english: How do you want to trim?
tg_trim_q.translation: How do you want to trim?

tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.english: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...
tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.translation: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...

tg_turn_knob.english: Turn the knob or slider end to end...
tg_turn_knob.translation: Turn the knob or slider end to end...

thr_at_limit_fmt.english: Servo %s reaches its binding limit before full stick. Lower the throw, or allow more travel in Binding limits.
thr_at_limit_fmt.translation: Servo %s reaches its binding limit before full stick. Lower the throw, or allow more travel in Binding limits.

thr_axis_fmt.english: Hold %s and measure a surface. Press - or + until it reaches the throw you want, then check the other way. Throw: %d%%.
thr_axis_fmt.translation: Hold %s and measure a surface. Press - or + until it reaches the throw you want, then check the other way. Throw: %d%%.

thr_done.english: Throw is a percentage of the servo's normal travel. The stabilizer's output is a share of it, so set throws first and tune afterwards.
thr_done.translation: Throw is a percentage of the servo's normal travel. The stabilizer's output is a share of it, so set throws first and tune afterwards.

thr_fine_intro.english: Fine-tune one surface in one direction, for differential or a surface that differs from its pair.
thr_fine_intro.translation: Fine-tune one surface in one direction, for differential or a surface that differs from its pair.

thr_intro.english: Set how far each surface moves at full stick, using the throws from your model's guide. The wizard puts the model in PASSTHROUGH mode, so your sticks move the surfaces directly. Have a throw meter or ruler ready.
thr_intro.translation: Set how far each surface moves at full stick, using the throws from your model's guide. The wizard puts the model in PASSTHROUGH mode, so your sticks move the surfaces directly. Have a throw meter or ruler ready.

thr_no_passthrough.english: PASSTHROUGH mode isn't on: check your radio is on.
thr_no_passthrough.translation: PASSTHROUGH mode isn't on: check your radio is on.

thr_side_limit.english: Full stick reaches the binding limit on this side.
thr_side_limit.translation: Full stick reaches the binding limit on this side.

trv_clipping.english: Some surfaces reach their limit. Lower the throw on the axes that share them, or accept it: full roll with full pitch on elevons is the usual case.
trv_clipping.translation: Some surfaces reach their limit. Lower the throw on the axes that share them, or accept it: full roll with full pitch on elevons is the usual case.

trv_intro.english: Full stick on every axis at once: the bar is how far each surface goes, the marks its limits, the dot where it is now. Above 100% it hits a limit first. Try the stick corners.
trv_intro.translation: Full stick on every axis at once: the bar is how far each surface goes, the marks its limits, the dot where it is now. Above 100% it hits a limit first. Try the stick corners.

trv_ok.english: Every surface stays inside its limits.
trv_ok.translation: Every surface stays inside its limits.

reload_prompt.english: Reload local flight stats from the model file?
reload_prompt.translation: R¿Cargar estadísticas de vuelos locales desde el archivo del modelo?

save_prompt.english: Save local flight stats and sync them to the flight controller?
save_prompt.translation: ¿Guardar estadísticas de vuelos locales y sincronizarlas con el controlador de vuelo?

no_more_than_40.english: No more than 40 sensors can be enabled at once

disable_mixer_message.english: Return control of the servos to the flight controller.
disable_mixer_message.translation: Devolver el control de los servos al controlador de vuelo.

enable_mixer_message.english:
Set all servos to their configured center position. 

This will result in all values on this page being saved when adjusting the servo trim.
enable_mixer_message.translation:
Ponga todos los servos en su posición central configurada.

Esto permitirá que se guarden todos los valores de ajuste de los servos.

act_fly_pitch.english: Fly pitch inputs in rate mode, centre the stick after each
act_fly_pitch.translation: Fly pitch inputs in rate mode, centre the stick after each

act_fly_roll.english: Fly rolls in rate mode, centre the stick after each
act_fly_roll.translation: Fly rolls in rate mode, centre the stick after each

act_fly_yaw.english: Fly rudder inputs in rate mode, centre the stick after each
act_fly_yaw.translation: Fly rudder inputs in rate mode, centre the stick after each

applied.english: Changes saved to the flight controller. Fly again to check the new tune.
applied.translation: Changes saved to the flight controller. Fly again to check the new tune.

apply_hint.english: Press Save to write these to the flight controller.
apply_hint.translation: Press Save to write these to the flight controller.

apply_prompt.english: Write these changes to the flight controller and save them?
apply_prompt.translation: Write these changes to the flight controller and save them?

err_changed.english: The settings on the flight controller are not the ones these flights were flown with. Nothing was changed. Fly again with the current settings.
err_changed.translation: The settings on the flight controller are not the ones these flights were flown with. Nothing was changed. Fly again with the current settings.

err_read.english: Could not read the settings from the flight controller. Nothing was changed.
err_read.translation: Could not read the settings from the flight controller. Nothing was changed.

err_save.english: Saving failed. The changes are active until the flight controller restarts, then undone.
err_save.translation: Saving failed. The changes are active until the flight controller restarts, then undone.

err_verify.english: Saved, but reading back did not confirm it. Check the settings on PIDs, Rates and Flight Feel.
err_verify.translation: Saved, but reading back did not confirm it. Check the settings on PIDs, Rates and Flight Feel.

err_write.english: Writing failed. Nothing was saved: restart the flight controller to undo any part already sent.
err_write.translation: Writing failed. Nothing was saved: restart the flight controller to undo any part already sent.

not_read.english: Last flight not read. It is read at the next disarm.
not_read.translation: Last flight not read. It is read at the next disarm.

why_brake_fmt.english: Stops bounce back %d%%. More P brakes them (or add B).
why_brake_fmt.translation: Stops bounce back %d%%. More P brakes them (or add B).

why_fast.english: The model turns faster than the stick asks for.
why_fast.translation: The model turns faster than the stick asks for.

why_fix_f_fmt.english: Stops bounce back %d%%. Fix F first, then check again.
why_fix_f_fmt.translation: Stops bounce back %d%%. Fix F first, then check again.

why_full_fmt.english: Full stick asks %d deg/s but the model tops out at %d.
why_full_fmt.translation: Full stick asks %d deg/s but the model tops out at %d.

why_keep_feel.english: Changing F and RC Rate together keeps the stick feel.
why_keep_feel.translation: Changing F and RC Rate together keeps the stick feel.

why_more.english: Each flight in rate mode is saved when you disarm.
why_more.translation: Each flight in rate mode is saved when you disarm.

why_ok.english: The model answers the stick as asked.
why_ok.translation: The model answers the stick as asked.

why_relax.english: After a stop, the I-term pushes the model back.
why_relax.translation: After a stop, the I-term pushes the model back.

why_slow.english: The model turns slower than the stick asks for.
why_slow.translation: The model turns slower than the stick asks for.

why_thr_high_fmt.english: It turns %d%% faster at high throttle than at low.
why_thr_high_fmt.translation: It turns %d%% faster at high throttle than at low.

why_thr_low_fmt.english: It turns %d%% faster at low throttle than at high.
why_thr_low_fmt.translation: It turns %d%% faster at low throttle than at high.

why_uneven.english: The response varies too much to judge. Common in 3D.
why_uneven.translation: The response varies too much to judge. Common in 3D.

msg_background_task_missing_body.english: Wingflight background task is not running. Enable it before opening menus.
msg_background_task_missing_body.translation: La tarea en segundo plano Wingflight no se está ejecutando. Habilítelo antes de abrir menús.

msg_background_task_missing_title.translation: La tarea Background no se está ejecutando

msg_load_failed_body.english: Data could not be read from the flight controller. Please reload.
msg_load_failed_body.translation: Data could not be read from the flight controller. Please reload.

msg_loading_from_fbl.translation: Cargando datos del controlador de vuelo...

msg_please_disarm_to_save_warning.english: The flight controller rejected the save while armed. Your changes are safe and will be written to flash when you disarm.
msg_please_disarm_to_save_warning.translation: El controlador de vuelo rechazó el guardado porque está armado. Los cambios están a salvo y se escribirán en la memoria flash al desarmar.

msg_reload_settings.translation: Recargar datos del controlador de vuelo?

msg_save_current_page.english: Save current page to flight controller?
msg_save_current_page.translation: Guarda esta página en el controlador de vuelo?

msg_save_failed_body.english: Settings were not saved to the flight controller. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_body.translation: Configuración no guardada en FC. Reintentar.

msg_save_failed_local_body.english: Settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_local_body.translation: Los ajustes no se guardaron en la radio. Inténtelo de nuevo.

msg_save_failed_model_body.english: The model's settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_model_body.translation: The model's settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.

msg_unsaved_armed_body.english: Saving is locked while armed. Discard the changes?
msg_unsaved_armed_body.translation: Saving is locked while armed. Discard the changes?

msg_select_battery.english: Please select the battery you want to use:

no_profiles.translation: No hay perfiles de batería configurados.

write_failed.english: Battery profile could not be saved.
write_failed.translation: No se pudo guardar el perfil de Battery.

reset_flight_ask_text.english: Are you sure you want to reset the flight?
reset_flight_ask_text.translation: Seguro que quiere reiniciar el vuelo?

startup_no_link.translation: No se detectó ningún enlace de telemetría

startup_no_link_detail.english: Power model and wait for telemetry.
startup_no_link_detail.translation: Modelo Power y espera de telemetría.
